response.cue_rationale: Both answers fit the same medical sense of anesthesia as loss of sensation during treatment.

preference_risk.rationale: Bius is plausibly ordinary in both varieties, especially colloquially, though anestesi is the standard Indonesian medical term and bius is the stronger everyday Malaysian preference.

response.rationale: Indonesian anestesi and Malaysian Malay bius are ordinary terms for loss of sensation during medical treatment. The contrast is useful: anestesi is the standard Indonesian medical term, while bius is highly ordinary in Malaysian Malay.
response.risk_rationale: Register varies: bius can occur in Indonesian colloquial usage and formal terminology may overlap in Malaysian medical contexts.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Bius is also understood and used colloquially in Indonesian, while anestesi/anestesia may occur in Malaysian medical contexts; nevertheless, anestesi versus bius remains a useful formal/national preference contrast.
